note: Both sets read every value, unit and condition correctly and bind them to the right components, with quotes that support the claims. Set B covers the same complete set of facts (HabEx 4 m / 4 instruments / 52 m starshade, LUVOIR-A 15 m / 4 instruments, LUVOIR-B 8 m / 3 instruments, Lynx 3 m / 10 m focal length / 3 instruments, Origins 5.9 m / 3 instruments) in 12 claims, while Set A reaches 16 claims only by restating three facts under slightly different entity names. Nothing is missing from either set, so Set B wins on concision and non-redundancy rather than correctness.
remarks: Set A repeats three facts under two entity spellings each: Lynx mirror assembly diameter 3 m, LUVOIR-A telescope diameter 15 m, and Origins telescope diameter 5.9 m. Both sets omit the formation-flying condition of the HabEx starshade spacecraft, which is arguably a condition of the starshade claim; minor and shared.
